_comment: Cross-language golden vectors for the goi- slug identity. A matching slug == a matching uuid5 resource id == cross-layer compose, so the FOUR implementations must agree byte-for-byte: Python src/goidelic/slug_identity.py, Rust app/src-tauri/src/tbx_parser.rs (entry), Rust app/src-tauri/src/builder_plugin.rs (concept), and JS scripts/lib/slug-identity.mjs (concept). A divergence silently breaks merge (see the Téarma-POS incident), so each implementation's unit test asserts against THIS file - edit the scheme and the vectors fail in every language at once. Two families: 'entry' (full normalisation: casefold+NFC+macron+ws->hyphen+strip-punct) is Python+Rust-tbx; 'concept' (lighter: NFC+lowercase+macron only, keeps spaces/apostrophes) is Rust-builder+JS. The apostrophe is the sharpest divergence probe: the entry slug drops it, the concept id keeps it.
